Attached: 1 image

When I started Langenium in 2012, I was mostly trying to see if I could get a multiplayer game working in a web browser. Now I'm  turning that proof of concept into an actual game with its own loops and mechanics.

I used to spend my time figuring out how to get the basics working. Now I'm figuring out what makes you want to play.

I've put a few shots from the latest build up on ArtStation.

Check it out here: https://www.artstation.com/artwork/ayEPm8
